name: Craig Poulton
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Relationship and Individual Counselling with depth and heart. Craig's therapeutic approach is fundamentally grounded in fostering the growth of awareness and compassion for self and other. It attends to the whole person, including thinking, talking and meaning making but also the wisdom and power of emotion and the unconscious.

name: David Williamson
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: David is a qualified and registered counsellor, and he utilises a non-judgemental, empathic, person-centred approach. He aims to support clients to develop an understanding of their difficulties in a way that facilitates growth and wellbeing. He does this by providing a safe therapeutic space that focuses on the client’s holistic needs, whilst introducing new skills and resources that build upon the client’s existing strengths.

name: Deanne Tonking
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Therapy that welcomes all parts of you I’m Deanne, an affirming, collaborative counsellor based in Coburg, Melbourne (Naarm). I work with adults navigating: anxiety, stress and burnout trauma and relational trauma grief, loss and life transitions chronic illness, pain and big health changes relationships, boundaries and loneliness sexuality, gender identity neurodivergence, ADHD and masking shame, self-worth and body image creative blocks and feeling stuck My approach is relational, person-centred and trauma-informed. I’m LGBTQIA+ and neurodivergent affirming, and I bring my own lived experience as a queer, neurodivergent woman who has navigated chronic illness. You also don’t need to be LGBTQIA+ or have a diagnosis to work with me.
